evidence.paragraph: For the quarter ended December 31, 2025, net income was $330.8 million, or $9.37 per diluted share, as compared to $145.9 million, or $4.09 per diluted share, for the quarter ended December 31, 2024. Revenue for the fourth quarter of 2025 was $2.65 billion compared to $1.87 billion in 2024. The Company reported operating cash flow of $468.5 million in the current quarter compared to $210.5 million in 2024.
